_doc: Token profiles per unit: median from a benchmark run (2026-10-21, 3 topics); p90 = 1.5 x median [ASSUMPTION until the ledger has samples]. items_generate is one item (5 per call were measured: output scaled by 0.4 [ASSUMPTION]). tree_outline is not measured [ASSUMPTION]. usd_notional: what the API would charge, shown for subscription CLIs. Recalibrated from live ledgers where a unit has at least 3 runs (see each note).
